name: Tsuchibami Mineko
source:
The wife of erotic novelist Tsuchibami Tetsuma. She married Tetsuma through an arranged marriage.

She has a very earnest personality and, despite being at the mercy of his sexual fetishes, she devotedly serves him.

Suspicious of her husband's disappearance, she asks Kuriko to investigate.

[Translated from the [url=https://hyperiyon.com/chris/chara.php]official website[/url]]
